expression_comparison.chosen_because: The remit is crowded ownership, not a rates call. AUDNZD is the packet’s most extreme crowding proxy, AU-NZ rates RV cannot be executed because NZ yields are missing, and the competing rates expressions are either a right-thesis/bad-entry duration short, a crowded post-FOMC steepener, or a CA-US RV whose weak-Canada fundamental still looks intact. Spot short AUDNZD owns the discrepancy where it lives.

considered_rates.assessment: AU 2Y 4.835% as of 2026-09-09 is 99.80th 1y and 99.96th 5y; US 2Y 4.67% on 2026-09-17 is 99.21st 1y. Receiving AU duration would fade crowded global bond shorts into an AU housing break, but AU inflation 82 means those shorts may still be the right thesis, the AU curve is eight days stale, and outright duration does not uniquely own the sharper AUDNZD crowding.

US 2s10s 27bp on 2026-09-17 is 1.39th percentile 1y after a 25bp 1m flattening. A post-hike steepener fades crowded flatteners, but after a >90% priced 25bp hike it is itself the consensus rates-desk trade this seat should attack, and August CPI kept a Fed tightening bias so flatteners may still be right.

CA-US 5Y -122bp as of 2026-09-16 is 0.20th percentile 1y (2Y -139bp, 10Y -109bp). Paying CA versus receiving US fades a crowded Canada-dovish/US-hawkish book, and BoC energy pass-through is less-owned, but CA labor 38 supports the crowd’s thesis, CA 2Y has already risen 38bp in 1m, and USDCAD is only 70.8th percentile 1y so spot is not confirming a flow squeeze. AU-NZ 2Y/5Y/10Y RV is unavailable after the RBNZ B2 HTTP 403.

considered_spot.assessment: Cleanest ownership expression: 5y 99.96th percentile, 5y z 2.96, 1m +2.94%. Related crowded cousins AUDCAD (5y 99.56th) and USDCHF (1y 99.80th) are inferior: USDCHF is a 1y not 5y extreme and sits inside the fully priced FOMC USD bid this seat refuses to join; AUDCAD is almost as stretched but less extreme than AUDNZD and mixes in weak CA labor.

trade.thesis: The frozen packet has no CFTC, skew, or CTA inventory, so crowding is inferred from price extremes and momentum that systematic longs would already own. AUDNZD is the most stretched G10 cross in the snapshot: ECB-reference 1.2388, 1y percentile 99.80, 5y percentile 99.96, 5y z 2.96, 1m +2.94%. That is the consensus high-yield AUD versus weak-NZD book. The state (NZ labor 32, activity 47, consumer 38 versus AU 50/54/48) is already why the crowd is long the cross. The change they do not own is Australian housing transmission: NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% YoY, volumes -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7% off peak, against AU yields still at a 5y extreme as of 2026-09-09. NZ’s India-trade legislation is incremental NZD-positive while NZDUSD sits at a 5y 11.5th percentile. Short AUDNZD sells the crowded AUD-outperform expression of global higher-for-longer without joining post-FOMC long-USD, short-duration, or 2s10s-steepener books that were already >90% priced into the 25bp hike.
why_now: AUDNZD prints a 5y 99.96th percentile with a still-positive 1m/5d/1d impulse, the strongest price-proxy for crowded CTA/momentum longs in the packet.
Fed 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00% arrived with >90% futures probability: long USD and short duration are known-information trades and a bad entry even if the inflation thesis is intact.
AU housing receipts/volumes/prices are the fresh tightening-channel print the AUD-outperform crowd is not positioned for.
NZ India-trade passage is a dated NZD-positive catalyst against a washed-out NZDUSD (5y 11.5th percentile).

The FOMC 25bp hike is known information; the housing print is the marginal AUD supply.
